data_description.name: Shown as the device name, e.g. the vehicle the battery is in.

user.description: Choose a battery monitor. Only supported monitors that a Bluetooth adapter or proxy can currently hear are listed.

data_description.name: Optional. Defaults to the model and the end of the address.

abort.no_devices_found: No supported battery monitors are in range of a connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported battery monitor.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to connect and read the monitor. Each poll connects for a few seconds, then disconnects.
data_description.chemistry: Used to estimate state of charge from resting voltage (this monitor doesn't report it). Choose None to hide the estimate.
data_description.history: After the monitor has been out of range (or Home Assistant was down), download its own log and fill the missing hours into long-term statistics.

konnwei_command.name: Send KONNWEI command
konnwei_command.description: Protocol research: connect to a KONNWEI monitor, send allow-listed commands (status, time sync, LED and data logging only) and return the raw replies.

listen.name: Listen time
listen.description: How long to collect replies after each command.
